intro: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable is a Peacekeeper bounty targeting a monstrous winged beast terrorizing the Shen'dar Highlands. Issued by Constable Aonda, the contract calls for adventurers to slay the ravenous vuldren and present her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.
Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
